title: A Millennium éve (1896) (The Millennium Year 1896)
grammar: Dual State Structures, Commemorative Postpositions & Urban Innovation Verbs

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what the Millennium of 1896 commemorated and what was built for it.
I can use emlékére and tiszteletére to say what a monument honours.
I can name Heroes' Square, the Millennium Underground and Vajdahunyad Castle in a citizenship interview.
I can read a short text about the Millennium celebrations and answer questions about it.
